name: Gourmet Foods Hawaii
old_description: providing the finest variety of products to Hawaii’s foodservice industry
about:
Gourmet Foods Hawaii operates from a facility on Kopke Street in Honolulu, supplying food products to the islands' foodservice sector. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. Business hours run Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 3 p.m.

The distributor carries a range of categories including appetizers, desserts, main courses, meats and seafood, pastry products, and specialty grocery items. It sources products globally and maintains a searchable online catalog with detailed product search functionality. No facility size, headcount, or volume figures are published.

Customers span Hawaii's foodservice industry, from restaurants and hotels to institutional kitchens. The company's brand-partner lineup includes recognized national and international labels, and its detailed catalog search supports menu development and procurement.

The firm's stated positioning is "Sourcing Globally, Serving Locally," emphasizing a bridge between international suppliers and local operators. The tagline reflects a focus on variety and reliability for Hawaiian foodservice buyers.
